item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description: Effective Date: 4/4/25 Thank you for using Icarus! This privacy policy informs you about how we handle data within the Icarus application. No Data Collection Icarus operates entirely on your device. We do not collect, transmit, or store any personal data or information created within the application. All data, including whiteboard strategies and any other content you create, remains solely on your device. No Internet Connectivity Icarus does not connect to the internet.
